topic: Concurrency and Sync Primitives for Parallel Processing
explanation: Concurrency involves multiple threads of execution running seemingly simultaneously, enabling parallel processing and increased responsiveness.  Synchronization primitives are mechanisms that coordinate access to shared resources by these concurrent threads, preventing data races and ensuring program correctness.  They are crucial in computer systems for managing shared memory and achieving efficient parallel computation.
